profile.headline: Software Engineer | Creative | Choreography & Dance
profile.summary:
For a movement specialist, visualization is everything. From my earliest days as a dancer I would picture every balletic shape, hear and see every tap step, and see movement in music and sound through my minds-eye daily. I grew the deepest love for symmetry and asymmetry (and an eye for it) and intense (though not always practical) attention to detail. As I grew in my career as a dancer - I learned how to take the details I learned as a performance artist and flip the table around to become the creator. This is where my fascination with coding and software development began.

As a creative, I am so invested in bringing tiny details into a whole picture. I love seeing a project build itself up from nothing... just as movement creation starts with a blank space and builds into telling complete and complex stories. Seeing projects come together from the build of a database, to the interweaving of code, to the ultimate design of the customer interface is so exciting to see. Picturing code in a 3 dimensional way gives the same arc, the same harmony, and the same beauty as a work of art to me

New York City Dance Alliance | Onstage New York

Systems Manager:

- Project Management & Implementation/Upkeep of PM Software (Monday.com)
- Business Rep (Apple Business, Verizon, AT&T, IT Solutions, etc)
- Technology Management (PCs/Apple/Shopify/etc.)
- Training of Employees & Training Guides
- Event Advancing (Catering, Trucking & Loading Docks, Room Dimensions, Security, etc)
- Involvement in (and documentation of) Audio/Video routing (Scarlett, BlackMagic, etc)
- Analyzing & Visualizing Data on fronts of Finance & in Athletic Competitive Scoring
- Organizational Structure of Packing, Inventory, and Processses for large scale Touring Events
- Organizational Structure of many aspects of Business Flow & Requirements
